# freecaseconverter.app

## Summary
freecaseconverter.app is a free, browser-based case converter tool. It converts text between 12 different case formats instantly, with no login, no backend, and no data leaving the user's device.

## Key Facts
- 100% client-side — no server, no database, no tracking
- 12 conversion formats: UPPER, lower, Title, Sentence, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, CONSTANT_CASE, dot.case, Alternating cAsE, iNVERSE cASE
- Supports up to 100,000 characters
- Loads in under 200ms
- Works offline via service worker
- Dark mode with persistent preference
- Mobile responsive and touch-friendly
- No frameworks — vanilla HTML, CSS, JavaScript
